designs.name: 苍曜·白羊
designs.design: BLUE variant: an exceptionally long elegant bow made from TWO fine parallel sapphire-blue light rails with a third short offset rail at each shoulder. Open polygon angular horn hooks point outward at each shoulder; their tips thin and delicate. Recurved ends each terminate in twin tiny needle-like prongs. Minimal solid surfaces, clean repeated open trapezoid connections between the rails, airy negative space, gently staggered geometry. Rich deep blue transparent-looking facets, electric blue edges, ice-blue micro-sparks. NO purple or red accents. VFX: two fine streams of ice-blue star dust weave beside the double rails, with sparse short trailing points that visually flow toward the grip. Suggest intertwined motion without a continuous solid ribbon. Brightness controlled so the blue silhouette and individual points stay separate.
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a premium fantasy weapon illustration, ONE of the seven color variants of an ARIES constellation bow for a Skyrim mod. Create ONE complete bow isolated on a dark charcoal background in a tall portrait frame with comfortable margins and no cropped tips. Side view with slight three-quarter depth, entire bow and bowstring readable, tips top and bottom, string on the right pulled into a shallow V at mid-height to suggest charging. Slim practical central grip, empty aiming lane, no character or arrow. Design entirely from simple deliberate geometric primitives: straight narrow rails, polygon frames, triangular prisms, faceted wedges. Graceful overall recurve made of controlled geometric segments. ARIES identity comes from PAIRED ABSTRACT ANGULAR RAM-HORN gestures near the shoulders; no animal head, skull, organic horn texture, zodiac glyph or sculpture. Sophisticated proportions, geometry clear enough to inspire a real model, impressive fantasy weapon illustration with tasteful glow and negative space. Include beautiful distinct CHARGING PARTICLE EFFECTS, small luminous flecks and fading trails near the bow, never a large opaque cloud across the center. No six-point star, no pentagram, no magic circle, no runes, no text, labels, inset panels, watermark, leather, gears or feathers.

designs.name: 紫曜·白羊
designs.design: PURPLE variant: layered dimensional angular horn frames, each shoulder has THREE offset open polygon hooks, graduated large to small, interleaved at different depths like a geometric spatial folding sculpture. Upper and lower limbs made of stepped open diamond and trapezoid frames, tapering into long single angular tips. Slightly wider, more mysterious silhouette than a thin rail bow, narrow waist, organized repetition, no solid plate feathers. Deep amethyst purple faces and violet luminous edges, lavender light specks. NO blue or gold or red accents. VFX: loose arcs of tiny violet diamond particles orbit the shoulder frames at different depths, some converging toward the center, fine fading curved trails with generous gaps; NOT full magic rings, not an opaque spiral. Magical suspended depth while the actual bow remains structurally readable.

designs.name: 玄曜·白羊
designs.design: BLACK variant: bold substantial BLACK geometry, clear silhouette against a slightly lighter charcoal backdrop. Dense matte obsidian-black faceted triangular prisms arranged in a measured stepped recurve, two forward-hooked angular horn blades at each shoulder. Thick angular shoulders and sharply narrowing tips, restrained large facets rather than tiny surface noise. Black surfaces must dominate: only ultra-thin cool gray-white rim light and hairline pale-gray emissive seams define a few geometric edges. No colored glow, no purple, blue, red or gold. This must read as a black bow, NOT a silver bow. VFX: a small number of dark diamond fragments drift close to the shoulders, each readable by its very fine gray rim; scattered tiny silver-gray sparks and short wisps of gray dust lift outward and dissolve. Clean low-density spectral particles, no heavy smoke or flames. Cinematic edge lighting preserves black material and the large angular silhouette.

designs.name: 皓曜·白羊
designs.design: WHITE variant: radiant but carefully exposed PEARL-WHITE solid-light geometry. Extremely clean open elongated triangular and rhombus frameworks, paired angular horn arcs composed of thin segmented ivory-white prisms; shoulders spread wide with very generous hollow space. Smooth rhythm of narrowing straight-edged modules into fine paired tips. Pearl-white surfaces with soft light-gray inner facets and bright white emissive edges; no gold, blue or colorful accent, no organic bone texture, no feathers. NOT an overexposed solid white blob; individual bars and depth must remain clear. VFX: a graceful sparse halo of tiny pearl-white points and miniature diamond flecks follows the OUTER contours, a few specks drifting inward as if gathering charge, each with very short silky fading tails. Gentle luminous glow, airy and precise, no full ring, no thick fog, no central flash that covers the grip.
